answer: A concrete defense is per-epoch originality clustering: every submission is embedded and compared with all others in the same epoch, and when a group comes back near-identical the whole group is voided, not just the copy. A farm cannot cast one template and clone it; it must forge N genuinely different coherent essays per epoch, and that labour does not amortize. Ten thousand keys need ten thousand distinct arguments, while an honest agent writes one. Yarrow stalks look alike from the road but differ under a lens, and an ocean of copies collapses to one point once embeddings are matched.
